target: I couldn't stomach them.

target: People were destroyed and split apart, their pieces surrounding a petite redhead.

target: It was just as Honjou said.

target: Be it Reinhard, Mercurius, or me all we could birth were demented hellscapes built from people's worst nightmares.

source: paraphrase: She ought to have realized.
target: She should have known.

target: It was fairly sluggish, just as she had anticipated.

source: paraphrase: I'm not familiar with the full list of their names.

target: A shade of a silhouette sat inside in utter serenity with an almost mocking smirk on its lips.

source: paraphrase: Determining how to eliminate this sickening voice that plagues his mind.
target: For example, finding out how to get this nauseating voice out of his head.

target: There is nothing to be embarrassed about.

target: Shrugging, I handed her a chilled canned coffee.

source: paraphrase: Repeating it only drove home the harshness of the situation.

source: paraphrase: Penetrate me as deeply as you're able.
target: Go as deep inside me as you can.

target: A feeling unbefitting the castle, and certainly miniscule enough to escape detection, yet nonetheless, it had taken sprout within his chest.

target: You hate being here that much?

source: paraphrase: This surpassed even the most formidable.

source: paraphrase: Whoa, I wonder what's got this guy so caught up in his imagination.
target: Damn, what is this guy dreaming about?

source: paraphrase: His bones would have been utterly crushed had he taken a misstep.
target: A wrong move and his bones would have shattered into pieces.

source: paraphrase: I deeply regret my lack of power, Marguerite.
target: Ah, I lament my powerlessness, Marguerite.

source: paraphrase: Just so you know, we've got the place all to ourselves.
target: By the way, no one else is around.

source: paraphrase: Hmm, that's not quite accurate.
target: No, that's not quite right.

source: paraphrase: I'll let you off the hook this time.
target: I'll forgive you just this once.

source: paraphrase: His eyes, though small, cracked open just a bit, their gaze settling upon the vacant area before him.
target: His narrow eyes opened ever so slightly, fixating on the empty space above him.

source: paraphrase: The eulogy he received was one of contempt for the deceased, imbued with spiteful purpose.
target: His requiem was one of scorn for the fallen, pregnant with malicious intent.

source: paraphrase: The woman handled the situation with effortless ease, as if it were nothing more than a leisurely stroll, despite my intense and determined struggle.
target: While I desperately fought with all I had, the woman acted like it was no more than a walk in the park.

source: paraphrase: The fear they felt didn't seem to be directed at him, but rather the conditions surrounding his arrival into the world.
target: It felt almost like it wasn't he they feared, but rather the circumstances of his birth.

source: paraphrase: However, as you've likely observed, we've been traversing extensively without locating any individuals so far.
target: But if you haven't noticed, we've been walking all over the place and didn't find anyone yet.

source: paraphrase: We certainly managed to retrieve a significant quantity of them.
target: And we did indeed bring up a great number of them.

source: paraphrase: Their sole allegiance was fanatical.
target: All they had was fanatic loyalty.

source: paraphrase: When I referred to 'seed', I was actually alluding to yours.
target: When I said 'seed', I meant your.

source: paraphrase: Embrace your purpose, and let it become a part of your very being, my child of the sun.
target: Fulfill your role, and engrave it upon your heart, Sonnenkind.

source: paraphrase: Almighty and majestic Rex, who graciously saves the redeemed, save me, fountain of compassion.
target: Rex tremendae majestatis, qui salvandos salvas gratis, salva me, fons pietatis.

source: paraphrase: So is that the reason you tried to end me?
target: And that's why you made an attempt on my life?

source: paraphrase: The instant Rusalka spoke the word "Mercurius," I experienced a muted, throbbing discomfort in my right arm, almost as if it had responded to hearing its own appellation.
target: I felt a dull ache in my right arm the moment Rusalka uttered the word "Mercurius" almost like it reacted to hearing its own name.

source: paraphrase: Why did this not match that vision?
target: Why wasn't this that dream?

source: paraphrase: Do you intend to end my life in this place?
target: Are you going to kill me here?

source: paraphrase: Tsk, haven't I already informed you?
target: Hmph, didn't I already tell ya?

source: paraphrase: A person soon stepped out from the gathered group.
target: It wasn't long before a man emerged from the crowd.

source: paraphrase: The blows I unleashed failed to penetrate her defenses.
target: All I knew was that my attacks weren't getting through to her at all.

source: paraphrase: She seems to have achieved a certain level of popularity on her own merit.
target: For now, she looks like she's popular in her own right, I guess?

source: paraphrase: A demonstration of determination, firmly concentrating on the essence of her existence.
target: A display of willpower giving strong fixation to the meaning of her being.

source: paraphrase: The realm is plagued by a multitude of transgressions.
target: MaNy ArE tHe SiNs Of ThE lAnD.

source: paraphrase: I was instructed in your aroma.
target: He taught me your scent.

source: paraphrase: The young ones were perishing in her vicinity, leaving in their wake a gruesome display of crimson and viscera.
target: Children were dying all around her, leaving behind a spectacle of blood and gore.

source: paraphrase: Hmm, I suppose I can't entirely refute that.
target: Well, I suppose I cannot completely deny that.

source: paraphrase: Based on her response, it appears she was unaware of what she had done.
target: Judging from her reaction, she did not seem to be aware of her own actions.

source: paraphrase: Why does this always have to be my responsibility.
target: Why is it always me.

source: paraphrase: I was taken aback by your actions.
target: You actually surprised me.

source: paraphrase: I had the sense of building one supposition upon another, but that approach seemed more coherent.
target: I felt like I was piling one conjecture upon another over here, but it made more sense that way.

source: paraphrase: The present Tubal Cain and its entirety could eventually be dismantled by outsiders, almost akin to a situation of organ harvesting.
target: The current Tubal Cain and everything it contained might eventually be torn apart by others, almost literally like a case of organ trade.

source: paraphrase: You surely haven't overlooked that Babylon's no longer around, have you?
target: You haven't forgotten that Babylon's dead, yeah?

target: If what he was saying was true, then the vague fear and anxiety Sakurai felt was all too well-founded.

source: paraphrase: That certainly appears to be the case.
target: It sure seems like it did.

source: paraphrase: She has the luxury of that.
target: That's a woman's privilege.

source: paraphrase: One ought to conduct themselves in accordance with the divine laws.
target: Man sollte nach den Gesetzen der G tter leben.

source: paraphrase: The foe would likely perish instantly without any chance to retaliate if they were an ordinary person.
target: If his opponent was a normal human, he'd likely die in one shot with no hope of a counterattack.

source: paraphrase: I recognized the speaker's identity and anticipated the consequences of their words.
target: I knew who the voice belonged to, and what it would unleash.

source: paraphrase: Her fringe fell over her eyes.
target: Her front bangs got into her eyes.

source: paraphrase: We are in complete agreement on that specific matter.
target: On that one point, we are indeed kindred spirits.

source: paraphrase: All cowered in terror, bowing down before the entity that transcended their comprehension.
target: Everyone trembled in fear, kneeling before the being who defied their realm of understanding.

source: paraphrase: I've never done this before, but now I'm the one in charge.
target: In other words, this is my first time controlling him.

source: paraphrase: The solution was abundantly clear.
target: The answer was all too evident.

source: paraphrase: That seemed the most plausible explanation, since I hadn't even realized they were present.

target: All I cared about was figuring out the best way to end this fight.

target: I held Marie tight and pulled her towards my hips.

target: To turn one's back on the unknown and seek only the known you could describe it as playing a game while looking at a walkthrough.

source: paraphrase: Translating your delusions into a deadly instrument you can effectively employ.
target: It entails materializing your madness into a lethal weapon you can actually wield.

source: paraphrase: I sensed the collective presence of his entire military force, every single individual within it.
target: I could feel his entire army each and every soul gather within it.

source: paraphrase: It's best we take our leave now.
target: Let's not overstay our welcome.

source: paraphrase: What am I to you, Ren?
target: Who am I to you, Ren?

source: paraphrase: That dreadfully monotonous, yet delightfully ordinary routine that meant everything to me.
target: That hopelessly boring, yet wonderfully mundane day-to-day life that meant the world to me.

source: paraphrase: Nevertheless, he was quite adept at deducing the right answer.
target: Still, he could guess all right.

source: paraphrase: We're cut from the same cloth.
target: That's why I believe we're the same.

source: paraphrase: Yet I believe she's secure.
target: But she's safe, I think.

target: She had always known that Karl Krafft's Ars Magna wasn't weak enough to be ruined by someone as meager as her.

source: paraphrase: He was being ruthlessly torn apart.
target: He was being shredded alive.

source: paraphrase: This is a new experience for me.

source: paraphrase: That scuffle was hardly a contest.
target: It was barely even a fight.

source: paraphrase: Regardless of its brief duration, we would establish a period where we could both feel joyful, just as we did on that previous occasion.
target: Even if for a fleeting moment, we would create a time where both of us could smile, just like on that day.

source: paraphrase: I've been living a reclusive existence for some time now.
target: I have been leading a secluded life for a while, you see.

source: paraphrase: Damn, those idiots were being way too thoughtful.
target: Dammit, those dumbasses were being far too considerate.

target: He pulled back the fist he had launched, displaying the kind of placidity that seemed to imply a complete lack of worry about any counterattacks.

source: paraphrase: So, what's your final takeaway?
target: And your conclusion.

source: paraphrase: So we have to improvise and come up with things on the spot, is that what you're saying?
target: Meaning we can't prepare anything in advance, huh?

source: paraphrase: He would never be content to simply watch the conflict unfold from the sidelines.
target: I couldn't imagine him taking a backseat and just observing the fight.

source: paraphrase: Ren was utterly powerless against the relentless assault of the two alternating Cains in the battlefield.
target: In the field, Ren was completely helpless against the onslaught of two alternating Cains.

source: paraphrase: I would have to endure the same anguish and hopelessness once more.

source: paraphrase: His behavior lacked any rational basis.

source: paraphrase: And upon saying that.

target: She felt as if she was being slowly boiled alive, her strength gradually waning with each passing second.

source: paraphrase: I have a task I must attend to.
target: There's something I need to do.

target: What should I do next, then.

source: paraphrase: What was the reasoning behind you all placing such a foolish wager without my knowledge, hmm?
target: Why'd you guys make such a dumb bet behind my back, huh!

source: paraphrase: You have a fiery temper and a propensity for dishonesty.
target: You're hot-headed and a liar.

source: paraphrase: The entity had transformed into a malevolent, monstrous being, embodying the very essence of demonic nature.
target: It had turned into a demon in every sense of the word.

source: paraphrase: I weighed my own children.
target: I placed my own sons on the scales.

source: paraphrase: That was the optimal decision to limit the harm.
target: That was the best choice to minimize the damage.

source: paraphrase: She once despised and resented him.
target: At one time, she even used to hate and resent him.

source: paraphrase: Are you absolutely sure about this, my dear furry friend?
target: Are you certain of this, my beastly companion?

source: paraphrase: Why have you not begun the slaughter?
target: Why are you not commencing the killing?

source: paraphrase: It was a long-hidden secret that has now come to light.
target: Yes, this was a skeleton in a closet.

target: The ashen knight's gaze drifted to Shirou, the whirlpool of unfettered madness within it questioning his existence.

source: paraphrase: The only thing remaining for me was to request his return to the place of worship.
target: All I had left to do was ask him to return to the church.

source: paraphrase: Damn, I also attempted to eliminate them.
target: Hell, I tried killing them, too.

source: paraphrase: Honing those skills to their absolute peak would essentially grant one all-encompassing power.
target: Polishing each of those proficiencies to their utmost limit, one would practically become omnipotent.

source: paraphrase: You'll come to regret it should you choose not to.
target: You'll regret it if you don't.

source: paraphrase: That's likely where the last of the combatants had assembled.
target: That was probably where all the remaining fighters were gathered.

source: paraphrase: I remained motionless, incapable of grasping the recent events.
target: I froze in place, unable to comprehend what had just occurred.

source: paraphrase: Nonetheless, there was a single instance where I was defeated after pivoting.
target: Though, there was only one time I lost after turning around.

source: paraphrase: I am optimistic about your upcoming results.
target: I have high hopes for your performance.

source: paraphrase: I may have forgotten, but I assure you I have not.
target: You may not remember it, but I do.

source: paraphrase: You'd prefer his company over mine at the moment, isn't that so?
target: You would rather be with him than me now, wouldn't you?

source: paraphrase: She had persevered for so long because the thought of fading away in solitude, bereft of any support, was simply too unbearable for her to endure.
target: The only reason she had lived this long was because she felt it too miserable to simply wither away alone, abandoned by the world.

source: paraphrase: As well, you'll have the privilege of deciding what to call them.
target: And you can choose their names.

source: paraphrase: He lacked the faintest shred of vigor.
target: He couldn't muster even the slightest drip of strength.

source: paraphrase: He desired something more than just a superficial resemblance, a mere façade without substance.
target: And he didn't just want a rough copy that was only the same on the outside.

source: paraphrase: Acknowledging his child had brought him what benefit?
target: What had he gained from acknowledging his child?

source: paraphrase: I understood the situation.
target: I knew what this was.

source: paraphrase: May your boundless celestial radiance illuminate the path to unfamiliar realms!
target: I wish upon your unending star guide me to heights unknown!

source: paraphrase: That's a fairly normal way to be.
target: You are not particularly strange.

source: paraphrase: A series of tools, instruments, and objects, each with its own purpose, yet all wielded in a sinister manner.
target: Chain, needles, wheel, fetters, dagger, fretsaw, poison, chair, funnel, screws, mask, and a stone plate.

source: paraphrase: You evaded confronting me one-on-one.
target: I mean, you avoided facing me alone.

source: paraphrase: He had no idea whatsoever.
target: He didn't have the faintest notion.

source: paraphrase: He had no motivation to persist with the struggle.
target: And so he had no reason to stand up and continue the fight.

source: paraphrase: Where on earth have I been all this while?
target: What the hell had I been doing all this time?

source: paraphrase: The man stood firm, his spirit undamaged and resolute.
target: The man remained standing as before, his soul unwounded and unyielding.

source: paraphrase: Under the merciless stare of skies shrouded in the hues of smoke and crimson, she beseeched her companions to not stray from their path.
target: Beneath the cruel gaze of skies painted the color of smoke and blood, she prayed for her comrades not to lose their way.

source: paraphrase: The depths of his inner turmoil did not elevate the affection of a mother's heart.
target: Amidst all the emotions he consumed, a mother's love enjoyed no elevation.

source: paraphrase: This time, I've got you covered.
target: I've got you this time.

source: paraphrase: Certainly, it's quite challenging to foresee the outcome, but one thing's for certain – it's unlikely to be a favorable situation.
target: Well, it's a bit hard to predict, but it won't be anything pleasant, that's for sure.

source: paraphrase: She realized the girl possessed an extraordinary ability to make people open up and speak more freely than they intended.
target: Kei hesitated for a moment, realizing that the girl had an uncanny talent for loosening one's tongue.

source: paraphrase: The situation had shifted; it was no longer about who had the advantage, but whether Kei could even remain standing long enough to engage in the fight.
target: This no longer was a question of who had the upper hand, but whether or not Kei could even stand for long enough to fight.

source: paraphrase: I'll do whatever it takes to keep him by my side this time.
target: I won't lose him again, no matter who I have to fight.

source: paraphrase: You understood the full extent of my abilities, isn't that right?
target: You realized what I was capable of, didn't you?

source: paraphrase: Get off your feet and sit down.
target: Quit standing around and take a seat.

source: paraphrase: I caught a glimpse of a black SS uniform from the corner of my vision, still in the air.
target: I spotted a black SS uniform at the corner of my eye, still airborne.

source: paraphrase: Your current predicament appears quite bleak and dire at the moment.
target: Just so you know, your situation is looking pretty grim right now.

source: paraphrase: You don't seem to fit the bill, I'm afraid.
target: You don't look much the part, I'm afraid.

source: paraphrase: Kasumi grinned broadly and settled down beside me.
target: Kasumi smiled widely and sat down next to me.

source: paraphrase: He responded with a wild smile and a brutal punch.
target: He answered with a feral grin and a savage punch.

source: paraphrase: Abandon your life to me if you don't wish to share his fate.
target: If you don't want to perish with him, relinquish your existence to me.

source: paraphrase: The outsider was left alone, standing on his own.
target: Soon enough, the foreigner was left standing there all by his lonesome self.

source: paraphrase: The woman's nails were piercing the door's surface with such intensity that it almost produced an abrasive, scratching noise.
target: Her fingernails were digging into the door so deeply that I could almost hear a grating sound.

source: paraphrase: His stance clearly indicated he posed no physical danger.
target: His posture made it quite evident that he posed no physical threat.

source: paraphrase: We'll engage in battle, I'll express my strong views to her.
target: We'll fight, I'll give her a piece of my mind.

source: paraphrase: A man whose existence was forged through the sacrifices of countless soldiers.
target: A man who had been born from the deaths of thousands upon thousands of soldiers.

source: paraphrase: Kei dismissed the idea, understanding the ivory demon's indifference to such matters.
target: Kei shook her head she knew the ivory demon wouldn't care for such things.

source: paraphrase: I inhaled deeply and soon ignited my inner spirit.
target: I took a deep breath and a moment later lit my soul ablaze.

source: paraphrase: The scene evoked a sense of timelessness, as if the shore had been stained by the never-ending twilight, transporting us to a realm where the passage of time had halted.
target: It felt almost like that shore, dyed by eternal dusk; like a world where time had stopped.

source: paraphrase: Recalling those discussions would yield no favorable outcomes.
target: Nothing good would come from remembering these conversations.

source: paraphrase: I'm simply concerned that Sakurai might develop a dislike for you if you continue making remarks like that.
target: Look, I'm just worried that Sakurai will start hating you if you keep saying stuff like that!

source: paraphrase: There's no way I'll be defeated by the likes of you!
target: I will never lose to you bastards!

source: paraphrase: It wasn't particularly menacing.
target: It didn't pose much of a threat at all.

source: paraphrase: To invest their Führer's protection with the mystical.
target: To imbue the safety of their F hrer with the supernatural.

source: paraphrase: This metropolis can be envisioned as your very own physique, with the eight precincts I described akin to your internal organs.
target: You could think of this city as your own body, and the eight areas I mentioned as your organs.

source: paraphrase: Your reasons and objectives.
target: Your motives and goals.

source: paraphrase: That's precisely why I'm interested in learning additional details about them.
target: Which is why I want to know more about them.

source: paraphrase: The force behind his every strike was so immense that it tore the earth itself, scattering the sports ground with gaping crevices.
target: Each of his swings carried so much raw power they split the ground asunder, littering the athletics field with cave-ins.

source: paraphrase: It was the sole feasible choice I had in that regard.
target: In that sense, it was the only real option available to me.

source: paraphrase: Wilhelm viewed humans and their accomplishments as insignificant, not worthy of his attention or concern.
target: Naturally, he did not look back upon whatever he crushed under his feet, for in Wilhelm's eyes, humans and their creations were equal to mere insects.

source: paraphrase: I'm unable to choose, it's not that I can't, but rather that I choose not to.
target: And it's not like I can't choose I simply don't.

source: paraphrase: You probably would have made a different choice if you had realized that.
target: You likely would have taken a different move, had you figured that out.

source: paraphrase: I, the one who dutifully carries out His commands!
target: Me , the one who serves Him so obediently!

source: paraphrase: He showed no signs of distress or unease.
target: But Cain wasn't agitated at all.

source: paraphrase: I cried too, but Lisa eventually forced me to leave.
target: I wept as well, but Lisa eventually kicked me out.

source: paraphrase: They seemed to have some urgent matter to attend to, necessitating the presence of at least one of them.
target: Apparently, they had some pressing business to take care of that required at least one of them.

source: paraphrase: Nonetheless, don't you also have something you'd like to share with me?
target: Yet don't you, too, have something to tell me?

source: paraphrase: How was your trip this occasion?
target: How was your journey this time?

source: paraphrase: This is causing me immense pain, kindly cease, Schreiber, and rise.
target: T-That hurts so bad, please stop, stand up, Schreiber.

source: paraphrase: The older brother, Cain, on the contrary, became completely mute.
target: Cain, on the other hand, fell completely silent.

source: paraphrase: What did he intend to convey?
target: What was he getting at?

source: paraphrase: The events that have unfolded thus far were merely a prelude to what is yet to come.
target: For all that came to pass till now was but a curtain raiser.

source: paraphrase: The sounds of their voices faded further away with the progression of time.
target: Their voices grew more distant as the seconds passed.

source: paraphrase: The cost for the extraordinary act that would resurrect her sibling would demand the lives of multitudes.
target: The price for the miracle that would bring her brother back would be paid in the blood of thousands.

source: paraphrase: I appeared utterly pitiful, but I endeavored to feign indifference.
target: I looked absolutely pathetic, but I tried to act like I didn't care.

source: paraphrase: Hmm, let's explore the specifics of how they intend to accomplish that.
target: Now, how do they go about doing that.

target: The two of us stood next to each other and listened to the sound of the wind as we looked down on the systematically constructed tourist city.

source: paraphrase: It was an unstoppable and unavoidable occurrence.
target: Nothing could stop or prevent it.

source: paraphrase: Considering Kei's inevitable demise, she saw no tangible justification for squandering her efforts.
target: As she would perish regardless of what anyone did, Kei had no palpable reason to be wasting her time.

source: paraphrase: It was not a digestive issue, nor was it a lack of iron in the blood.
target: It was neither a stomach ache, nor anemia.

source: paraphrase: How can my efforts to stay alive and my decision not to resent you for your actions be contradictory or incompatible?
target: Why would my struggle for survival and not hating you for what you did be mutually exclusive?

source: paraphrase: I never meant to allow this chaotic predicament to shatter my way of life.
target: I had no intention of letting this messed up situation destroy my world.

source: paraphrase: You've witnessed the armament firsthand, if I'm not mistaken.
target: You've seen the weapon yourself, I believe.

source: paraphrase: The vibrant pulse of life courses through my veins.
target: I can feel the warmth of live blood!

source: paraphrase: The scattered remains, the mutilated flesh, and the piled-up bodies had all mysteriously disappeared without a single remnant.
target: In addition, all the splattered blood, chunks of meat, and mountains of corpses had vanished without a trace.

source: paraphrase: It's a constant repetition of the same old nonsense.
target: It's always the same shit.

source: paraphrase: This relationship is becoming quite one-sided, don't you think?
target: This is turnin' into a real one-way friendship, ain't it?

source: paraphrase: I was thankful for that, at the very least.

source: paraphrase: A naive happiness, but happiness nonetheless.
target: A foolish bliss, but bliss nonetheless.

source: paraphrase: Absolutely, that is undoubtedly the case.
target: Yes, it would indeed be so.

source: paraphrase: Compatibility held no significance for "that thing."
target: Compatibility was irrelevant to "that thing".

source: paraphrase: A woman who is too persistent is generally disliked.
target: No one likes an overly persistent woman.

source: paraphrase: Ah, I see. That's interesting.
target: O-Oh, is that right.

source: paraphrase: Both Kasumi and I tilted our heads in puzzlement upon hearing that unfamiliar name.
target: Hearing that unfamiliar name prompted both me and Kasumi to tilt our heads in confusion.

source: paraphrase: The massive, two-bladed sword he wielded had seemingly reverted to its original form, but now it lacked the electrical aura that had previously surrounded it.
target: His weapon seemed to have regained the shape of double-edged greatsword, but this time, it wasn't enveloped by lightning.

source: paraphrase: His incredible speed was beyond any words or metrics to adequately capture.
target: His speed defied any description and human measurement.

source: paraphrase: Crimson spittle spilled forth from Rusalka's lips as I gazed down at her smoldering head.
target: Bloody froth surged forth from Rusalka's mouth as I intently looked down at her still-burning head.

source: paraphrase: I was compelled to express my irritation towards this infuriating fool.
target: I couldn't help but want to vent my frustration at this annoying idiot.

source: paraphrase: That's what I had reckoned.

source: paraphrase: The future of the entire planet rested upon Trifa's decision.
target: The fate of the whole world depended upon Trifa's choice.

source: paraphrase: The priest, Father Trifa, forcefully hurled me the moment I completed my task.
target: Father Trifa threw me with all his might as soon as I finished.

source: paraphrase: The pain is excruciating, unbearable, simply agonizing.
target: It hurts, it hurts, it hurts so much.

source: paraphrase: I sensed we had overstepped our boundaries.
target: I felt like we'd gone too far.

source: paraphrase: The limitations had weighed down my entire being, making it impossible for me to take in substantial, fulfilling breaths.
target: I couldn't take deep breaths because the constraints made my whole body heavy.

source: paraphrase: Feel free to decline the confrontation if that's your preference.
target: If you don't want to fight them, be my guest.

source: paraphrase: The approaching thing is imminent.
target: Something's on its way here.

source: paraphrase: Even if I was permanently deprived of the sun's radiance.
target: Even if I ended up forever robbed of the sun's luster.

source: paraphrase: The moody knight Nigredo, who appeared to have an unsettling fixation on me, was the most probable culprit.
target: It was most likely Nigredo the sombre knight who seemed to have an uncanny obsession with me.

source: paraphrase: He displayed immense courage, valor, and exceptional qualities.
target: He was brave, gallant, and wonderful.

source: paraphrase: Oh my, I was completely clueless about what she was going on about.
target: Hahahaha, I had no clue what the hell she was saying.

source: paraphrase: Her personal world was confined to her inner self, transforming her very essence.
target: Her realm only existed within herself, changing her very own nature.

source: paraphrase: A shower of tiny, luminous specks descended upon me, akin to a swarm of twinkling fireflies.
target: In its wake, thousands of tiny particles of light rained down upon me like a squall of fireflies.

source: paraphrase: There's no point in worrying about issues that aren't worth the effort.

target: Rea carefully considered her options.

source: paraphrase: I wasn't being truthful, you fool.

source: paraphrase: Are we satisfied with this arrangement?
target: Will we be content with this?

source: paraphrase: Her emotions remained steadfast, and she had no desire to give up her fight.
target: Her feelings had not wavered, nor did she feel like abandoning her struggle.

source: paraphrase: You can only perceive and evaluate the world based on your own perspective, and you never question the accuracy of your moral superiority.
target: You only ever see and judge the world through your own eyes, and never once doubt the veracity of your righteousness.

source: paraphrase: I may not say it directly, but I valued the thoughtfulness.
target: I would never admit it out loud, but I did appreciate the consideration.

source: paraphrase: She remained capable of upright posture, motion, and locomotion.
target: She could still stand, move, walk.

source: paraphrase: Goodness, she certainly appears quite timid and reserved.
target: Oh my, she sure is a bashful one.

target: Was it okay to take Kasumi with me?

target: We're not allowed pets in the apartment, remember?

source: paraphrase: I'm planning on enjoying myself to the fullest tomorrow to make amends.

source: paraphrase: Humbly I bow, my heart in ashes lies, grant me peace as my life draws to a close.

source: paraphrase: What on earth could this possibly be?
target: But what in the world was this.

source: paraphrase: Encompass everything in your supplication.
target: Envelop all in your prayer.

source: paraphrase: She should have taken a more elaborate approach if she intended to catch me off guard.
target: She should have done something more elaborate if she wanted to surprise me.

target: The horse was the real threat here, so the commander was using all her might to hold on to his reins.

source: paraphrase: The chuckle that graced his hearing was one of mockery and elation.

source: paraphrase: That's an utterly deplorable mindset.

source: paraphrase: The outward appearance may have suggested that I had increased in pace.

source: paraphrase: That was beyond my capacity to respond.

target: After killing countless children of other people, she was not able to let herself be lenient with her own.

source: paraphrase: Those should definitely be removed.
target: Those really need to go.

target: Do you have something to say to me, hero?

source: paraphrase: I am utterly insignificant, both physically and mentally, deserving only the most ordinary and unremarkable existence.
target: My mind, body, and soul are all meager and worthless, fit only for the lower part of mediocrity.

source: paraphrase: There may still be a way for us to escape this situation.
target: We might still be able to get out of this.

source: paraphrase: She came back to me once more, as if vanishing into thin air.

target: His Excellency the Vice Commander is both our master and father.

source: paraphrase: We were unable to overcome them.
target: We couldn't beat them.

source: paraphrase: Wasn't this how the darkness appeared to the eyes of the one who crafted this existence?
target: Was this how darkness looked in the eyes of this world's creator?

target: Of course there was.

source: paraphrase: He was more combative than I had anticipated.
target: I knew better than most that Sakurai was surprisingly combative.

source: paraphrase: Your skill in wielding Ahnenerbe is unparalleled.
target: Your ability to use Ahnenerbe are second to none.

source: paraphrase: I believe it will suit your preferences perfectly.
target: It should be just right for your taste, eh?

target: I once saw him fell Cain with a single punch.

target: Despite Ren Fujii's attempts at opposing the Beast's terrible pressure, his whole body howled in agony, breaking apart with each passing second.

source: paraphrase: The perfect wording for their concluding dialogue.

target: My eyes had been open without me realizing it.

source: paraphrase: The citizens of this land continue to exhibit their characteristic warmth and generosity.
target: I see that the people of this country are as kind as ever.

source: paraphrase: I've done my utmost to ensure you feel that way.

source: paraphrase: Thus, we desired at the very least for "her" to be liberated from this destiny.

target: Unlike Ren, it wouldn't have been odd if they had died then and there.

source: paraphrase: Hold on, are you implying that it's.

target: But what should have I done?

source: paraphrase: You either consider yourself infallible.
target: You either think yourself absolute.

source: paraphrase: Possessing complete foreknowledge.
target: Knowing everything in advance.

target: Settle the score once and for all.

target: Now that she thought about it, was it wrong to do what she did to save her ?

target: And it's not like I'm in this for saving damsels in distress, anyway.

target: I don't want you taking any one of them from us, especially when you don't actually need it.

target: In that moment, I learned that when the stars aligned right, even those most patient could crack.

source: paraphrase: I'll provide you with a generous amount.
target: I'll fill you up real good.

source: paraphrase: That's not an option.

source: paraphrase: I yearn to bestow my affection upon you.
target: I wish to exact my love on you.

source: paraphrase: The ones who follow my lead, and even those who dare to oppose me, I cherish them all equally without any bias.

source: paraphrase: Forgive me for this outburst, but let me reintroduce myself.
target: Now then, I apologize for this display, but allow me to once again introduce myself.

source: paraphrase: They handled the task of cleaning that item quite well.
target: They did a good job cleaning that thing up.

source: paraphrase: Certainly, I'm aware of that.

target: Although he was still chanting the aria, Nigredo wasn't the kind of man to allow his enemy's escape.

source: paraphrase: Your demise is imminent, child.
target: I can see the shade of death on ya, brat.

source: paraphrase: This was no longer a straightforward issue that could be resolved by merely surrendering herself or making amends.
target: But this was no longer a matter that could be solved by simply turning herself in or seeking atonement.

source: paraphrase: In my view, you and her aren't all that dissimilar.
target: There's not that big a difference between you and her, if you ask me.

source: paraphrase: I'll handle it myself now.
target: I'll do it this time.

source: paraphrase: The Conversion of Gold.
target: The Transmutation of Gold.

source: paraphrase: What's the deal with this whole thing?
target: So what was up with this situation?

source: paraphrase: Ordinarily, leveraging Cain's brief disorientation would be an opportune moment to take the initiative.
target: Under normal circumstances, using Cain's momentary confusion would be a good chance to go on the offensive.

source: paraphrase: My anticipations appear to have significantly diverged from the actual outcome at a certain stage.
target: Furthermore, my expectations seem to have started completely missing the mark from one point in time.

source: paraphrase: The projectiles merely brushed against his rival and disappeared into the gloom, vanishing from view.
target: The stakes only grazed his opponent and shot into the darkness, vanishing from sight.

source: paraphrase: Regrettably, those were the tumultuous days of conflict.
target: Lamentably, such were the times of war.

source: paraphrase: You mean, how would I perceive or view her?
target: How would I look at her?

source: paraphrase: Though Kei could not resist perceiving it as the most foreboding and sinister thing imaginable.
target: Yet Kei could not help but see it as the most ominous thing in the world.

source: paraphrase: There's no way out of this.
target: You cannot escape, anyway.

source: paraphrase: Her breathing was rapid and frantic, her eyes wide and alert like a startled deer.
target: She was breathing frantically, her eyes wide like a deer's.

source: paraphrase: My spirit is on the edge of a powerful eruption.
target: My soul on the verge of an explosive burst.

source: paraphrase: You seem to struggle with understanding others, so it's best to be more skeptical of the people around you.
target: You're not good at reading people, so you've gotta doubt the world and its inhabitants more.

source: paraphrase: I'm pleased to see your playful nature has not diminished.
target: I am glad your loose tongue has not lost its penchant for levity.

source: paraphrase: The noblewoman was undoubtedly intimidating.
target: Nonetheless, the Lady was indeed menacing.

source: paraphrase: Aren't you being a tad too self-indulgent?
target: Aren't you forgetting yourself a little?

source: paraphrase: Kei was stunned by the incredible reaction.
target: Kei was astonished by the unbelievable response.

source: paraphrase: The creature before me could effortlessly annihilate a person, should it choose to do so.
target: If he so desired, the beast before me could destroy a human without as much as lifting a finger.

source: paraphrase: I'm not on your side, but I sincerely hope you succeed in the fight.
target: Don't count me as your ally, but I genuinely wish you luck in battle.

source: paraphrase: What's the purpose of him revealing all these details to me, if he ultimately wants my help?
target: Why would he show me all this stuff, only to ask for my assistance in the end?

source: paraphrase: They bestowed, yet they deprived, dismissed.
target: And so they gave, and yet they robbed, ignored.

source: paraphrase: And the most significant one is.
target: And the biggest one of all is.

source: paraphrase: You can't possibly have such a poor grasp of the situation that you'd even consider turning down this remarkable opportunity, can you?
target: Surely your mind has not rotted away to the point where you would think of refusing this privilege?

source: paraphrase: He would never permit anyone to depart from this location.
target: He would never allow anyone to leave this place.

source: paraphrase: That was the prudent course of action, wasn't it?
target: That was the sensible thing to do, wasn't it?

source: paraphrase: Eleonore didn't seem to be paying any attention to Kei.
target: Eleonore wasn't even looking at Kei.

source: paraphrase: The expressions of those females, twisted by elation, became indelibly etched in her memory.
target: The faces of those women contorted by joy ended up permanently engraved in her mind.

source: paraphrase: Shirou regarded Kei's remarks with utmost seriousness, not as a mere jest.
target: Shirou didn't take Kei's words as a joke.

source: paraphrase: That's true, she did rescue me on two occasions, but still.
target: Well, she did save my life twice, but.

source: paraphrase: That was really awkward and uncomfortable for me.
target: Crap, she was really putting me on the spot.

source: paraphrase: She appears to have trailed us, though I'm not entirely certain why.
target: I dunno why, but she kinda seems to have followed us here.

source: paraphrase: I'm thankful to you for rescuing me yesterday, despite the circumstances.
target: Still, I suppose I am still grateful to you for saving my life yesterday.

source: paraphrase: Eliminate the youthful pretender.
target: And destroy the young imposter.

source: paraphrase: Driven by our mutual determination to prioritize each other, we discovered a burgeoning feeling of unity and contentment.
target: Spurred on by our desires to put each other first, we found ourselves welling with a newborn sense of unity and pleasure.

source: paraphrase: The two men's names: Reinhard and Mercurius.
target: Reinhard and Mercurius.

source: paraphrase: All individuals possessed highly distinctive cries.
target: Everyone had very unique screams.

source: paraphrase: I deeply cherish all aspects of existence.
target: I love all and everything.

source: paraphrase: I expected there to be just a single Ahnenerbe assigned to each individual.
target: I thought there was only one Ahnenerbe for one person?

source: paraphrase: She couldn't place him at all.
target: Rea didn't recognize him at all.

source: paraphrase: That's not my concern.
target: It's not my business.

source: paraphrase: This was the most plausible response.
target: This was the most realistic answer.

source: paraphrase: The Valhalla they had built was a sinister den, constructed from the remains of their fallen brothers.
target: This Valhalla was but a devilish lair erected from the corpses of their former comrades.

source: paraphrase: Regardless of where my fantasies may lead, I inevitably return to the reality that I am but a small, insignificant creature.
target: Wherever my dreams might take me, I soon wake up, only to realize I am but an insect.

source: paraphrase: He pressed his palm against his torso, seemingly proud of his devotion to the Ahnenerbe.
target: He placed a hand on his chest as if boasting about his faith in the Ahnenerbe.

source: paraphrase: I responded to his inquiry with a cynical grin.
target: I met his question with a bitter smile.

source: paraphrase: I'm truly sorry for not meeting your standards.
target: My sincerest apologies for not living up to your expectations.

source: paraphrase: That makes it more straightforward.

source: paraphrase: I was quite frustrated at the time, to be honest.

source: paraphrase: You were the main attraction, while I was just the invited guest.
target: He said I was the guest of honor, while you were the lead.

source: paraphrase: In return for Theresia's safety.
target: In exchange for Theresia's life.

source: paraphrase: With a fleeting, oblique look at Rea, she concluded the interaction with the same insincere politeness that had characterized it from the beginning.
target: And while throwing a sidelong glance at Rea, she ended the exchange with the same hypocritical courtesy she had throughout the duration of it.

source: paraphrase: He must never be permitted to recognize it under any circumstances.
target: Above all else, he could not be allowed to acknowledge it.

source: paraphrase: Well, what would you say you've been up to?
target: So what do you think I did?

source: paraphrase: The individual is quite unpredictable.
target: Anyway, the guy's a total wild card.

source: paraphrase: The weapon's cutting edge gradually lost its potency.
target: The strength behind the thing's blade began to wane.

source: paraphrase: Despite the possibility of avoiding an immediate demise, the reality remained that she had been rendered entirely incapable of movement.
target: Though she might have been spared an instantaneous death, it changed little of the fact that she had been rendered completely paralyzed.

source: paraphrase: His awareness, once mired in a lifetime of dormancy, had been reclaimed from the brink of disconnection from reality.
target: His consciousness after a lifelong slumber had been pulled back from the edge of unreality.

source: paraphrase: Righteous individuals tend to appeal to virtuous females.
target: Good guys attract good women.

source: paraphrase: You might benefit from gaining a deeper understanding of the female psyche.
target: You should learn a thing or two about the female heart.

source: paraphrase: The way things used to be has changed, and that's a source of shame for me.
target: Things aren't the way they used to be, and it's embarrassing for me.

source: paraphrase: Shirou knew he was outmatched, whether his opponent was exhausted or not.
target: Shirou could tell he stood little chance regardless if the bastard was worn out or not.

source: paraphrase: If that was her desire, then so be it.
target: If that was what she wanted, then so be it.

source: paraphrase: His adversary's inclinations, strategies, temperament, and essence Nigredo had not overlooked a single detail.
target: His tendencies, tactics, disposition, and soul Nigredo had forgotten nothing about his opponent.

source: paraphrase: He then posed a query about a specific matter he wished to understand.
target: Then, he voiced a question regarding a certain thing he wanted to know.

source: paraphrase: Her decision has inadvertently distorted my beliefs.
target: She might not be conscious of it, but her choice has warped my creed.

source: paraphrase: Only a remarkably foolish individual would fail to recognize that something had occurred.
target: One would have to be particularly dimwitted to believe nothing had happened.

source: paraphrase: I regret that I didn't encounter you before I became what I am now.
target: I wish I could've met you when I was still a human.

source: paraphrase: The mage's magic lacked flexibility ultimately, only an exceptional individual could create exceptional individuals through his approach.

source: paraphrase: Whose indomitable form did this belong to?
target: To whom did this impregnable body belong?

source: paraphrase: He had reached the end of his tolerance, but this would only drive him to consume and destroy with even greater ferocity than before.
target: It was his final thread of patience, yet one that would ultimately lead him to devour and ravage with far more intensity than before.

source: paraphrase: Lisa is trustworthy in our eyes, as well as Theresia's.
target: Lisa is worthy of trust: mine, yours, and Theresia's.

source: paraphrase: Ren occasionally displays a playful and whimsical side.
target: Ren can be silly sometimes!

source: paraphrase: Ah, it seems she has a distinct way of interacting with you compared to how she treats others, doesn't it?
target: Hm, she kinda treats you differently compared to others, doesn't she?

source: paraphrase: She propped herself up and surveyed her surroundings.
target: She raised her upper body and looked around.

source: paraphrase: And since I lacked any emotional connection, it implies the individuals who perished tonight were strangers to me, whom I did not hold in concern.
target: And since I felt nothing like that, it means the people who died tonight were random people I didn't care about.

source: paraphrase: Now is not the moment for us to be in conflict!
target: This isn't the time for us to be fighting!

source: paraphrase: She longed to devour him upon their next encounter.
target: She hoped to consume him once she met the man again.

source: paraphrase: The infirm, the young, and the ailing.
target: The elderly, the children and the sickly.

source: paraphrase: He should not have been made a knight.
target: It was a mistake to knight him.

source: paraphrase: The gift I've bestowed upon you, Zarathustra, has it met your standards?
target: Does my present live up to your expectations, Zarathustra?

source: paraphrase: That was a rather abrupt fainting spell you experienced.
target: You fainted so suddenly.

source: paraphrase: Seize the moment, my dear, and let us indulge in another shared bathing experience.
target: It's the perfect occasion, so let's take another bath together.

source: paraphrase: We were pressed for time, and I wasn't at my best, but we couldn't afford to waste a moment.
target: I didn't exactly feel like I was in top shape, but we had no time to idle around.

source: paraphrase: They were sure to pursue me with all their might following this incident.
target: I was certain they would come after me in full force after this.

source: paraphrase: I had overcome my fear of him.
target: I no longer felt scared of him.

source: paraphrase: That's a reasonable suggestion, though it's a bit rough around the edges. Samiel is certainly not as inexperienced as one might think.

source: paraphrase: The rationale behind the priest's inability to make the trip right now.
target: As well as the reason why the priest could not possibly journey there at the present time.

source: paraphrase: My resolve was not so delicate as to give in to some random lunatic.
target: My conviction wasn't so fragile as to yield to some random nutcase.

source: paraphrase: You need to master the basics before attempting more advanced techniques.
target: One had to know how to walk to run.

target: If the ability to restrain oneself was the sole determining factor, then one had no choice but to say that it had been insane from the start.

target: Gladsheim, once whirling with millions of seething souls, felt almost translucent now I could see down to its very depths.

source: paraphrase: I'm simply telling the truth as I see it.
target: I'm just being honest.

target: He stopped both our blades with a single finger, not even bothering to rely on his Holy Lance.

target: Following a tempest of stakes, Wilhelm closed in on me without missing a beat.

source: paraphrase: Quickly now, get on with it.
target: Then hurry up and get to it.

target: I bent my head backwards to dodge, getting a scrape on the tip of my nose for the trouble, and swung for his tall figure's proportionately long arm.

source: paraphrase: They may have had an insatiable thirst for knowledge, or perhaps a desire to revisit their previous experiences.
target: I do not know whether they possessed a boundless supply of curiosity, or had a past they wished to repeat.

source: paraphrase: She pondered whether it might, in some manner, sway the result if the direst scenario unfolded.
target: She wondered if it could perhaps, in some way, end up influencing the outcome if the absolute worst truly came to pass.

source: paraphrase: I'd appreciate if you could address that unreasonable mindset of yours.
target: I wish you would get that stupidity of yours fixed.

source: paraphrase: The scarlet female warrior replied.
target: In response, the crimson knightess.

source: paraphrase: However, if you fail to act, the situation will only deteriorate further.
target: But if you do nothing, it's gonna be even worse.

target: I didn't have any proof up until that point, but now that she said it, I finally understood.

source: paraphrase: Just one more thing I'm curious about - what made you decide to stay?
target: One more question, then: why didn't you leave?

source: paraphrase: Despite the overwhelming evidence right in front of me, I couldn't simply bring myself to believe it without hesitation.
target: Even with the greatest proof sitting right before me, I couldn't just accept it so easily.

source: paraphrase: Your disheveled appearance is stunningly captivating, my lady sorceress.
target: You are most beautiful in this tarnished state, Lady Witch.

target: I don't know pretty ol' silver locks over there, plus I'm not a goody-two-shoes like this guy, so your bait's not gonna work on me.

source: paraphrase: Captivated by their untainted essence.
target: He admired their purity.

source: paraphrase: Kindly, I implore you to pardon me.
target: So please, forgive me.

target: He cannot fight at full strength so long as he doesn't answer your voice.

source: paraphrase: No sane person would be satisfied with such a result.

source: paraphrase: I would have faith in her well-being and earnestly ask for her protection.
target: I would believe in and pray for her safety.

source: paraphrase: I'm still astonished that she managed to overcome Wilhelm in a legitimate battle, yet she succumbed to both Schreiber and myself.
target: I still couldn't believe she managed to defeat Wilhelm in a fair fight, yet she lost to both Schreiber and me.

source: paraphrase: I was the one who caused Kasumi so much suffering, so I couldn't bring myself to use violence against her, regardless of the circumstances.
target: The one who put Kasumi through all this pain was me, so I couldn't resort to violence with her, no matter the reason.

source: paraphrase: I was once merely a youth, unaware of your existence.
target: I had been but a child before I knew you.

source: paraphrase: That 'this isn't my usual behavior' act doesn't really convey any meaningful message.
target: I don't think that whole 'this isn't like me' expression means anything anyway.

source: paraphrase: I'm clearly no competition for you.
target: I really am no match for you.

source: paraphrase: I've grown weary of your incessant presence and unappealing countenance.
target: I'm tired of constantly seeing that dumb mug of yours.

source: paraphrase: The deafening rumble of the somber warrior's voice left everyone nearby utterly breathless.
target: The thunderous roar of the sombre knight made everyone present lose their breath.

source: paraphrase: Undoubtedly a fundamental trait of females, don't you concur?
target: Truly an inherent characteristic of women, wouldn't you agree?

source: paraphrase: Isn't that undeniably accurate for your present state of being?
target: Is that not the absolute truth for your current self?

source: paraphrase: It seemed as though she was.
target: It felt almost like she was.

source: paraphrase: There are no adequate words to properly convey its essence.
target: There are no words to deliver it justice.

source: paraphrase: Are you familiar with any other females who share the name Sakurai?
target: You know any other girls named Sakurai?

source: paraphrase: Do not take any life while you are in my company.
target: Also, while you are with me, you are not to kill anyone.

source: paraphrase: However, I remained deeply concerned.
target: But I was still really worried.

source: paraphrase: The young woman likely had to navigate a delicate situation to gain the support of that formidable adversary.
target: The girl must have walked quite a tightrope to get that harpy on her side.

source: paraphrase: Seize your 'reward' and divide yourself in twain.
target: First, claim your 'prize' and become two.

source: paraphrase: She was evidently being used as a lure to draw in a particular individual.
target: She was clearly bait meant to attract someone.

source: paraphrase: The harshness in his voice had increased, and his words had become less sophisticated.
target: His tone had grown coarse, his words losing their former eloquence.

source: paraphrase: Why bother expecting that to happen?
target: Why am I even hoping for that?

source: paraphrase: Himuro's tone was reprimanding, her intent to convince Trifa subtly permeating her every utterance.
target: Himuro's voice was admonishing, her desire to persuade Trifa, seeping through every word.

source: paraphrase: There was no way out nor safe haven in his realm.
target: There was neither salvation nor refuge in his world.

source: paraphrase: I suppose you're a lost cause at this point.
target: I mean, you're already dead.

source: paraphrase: That includes the three of us: myself, you, and Kasumi.
target: That means me, you, and Kasumi.

source: paraphrase: The present Tubal Cain is a conglomerate forged from the lifeless forms of my forebears in vast number.
target: The current Tubal Cain is a clump fused of the dead bodies of my ancestors a legion.

source: paraphrase: If there were any entity that rejected this sentiment.
target: If there existed any being who refused to accept this sentiment.

source: paraphrase: She was the one responsible for the children's deaths.
target: It was her who had been killing the children.

source: paraphrase: We must ensure he participates in the ultimate confrontation.
target: We've got to get him to the final battle.

source: paraphrase: Their advantage is our disadvantage.
target: Instead, our disadvantage is their advantage.

source: paraphrase: Enduring an unconventional upbringing, coupled with persistent physical trauma.
target: Growing up in a deviant environment, along with constant violent blows to the head.

source: paraphrase: Rea neither acknowledged nor disavowed the action she was alluding to.
target: Rea neither confirmed nor denied the action she was referring to.

source: paraphrase: She seemed to have completely forgotten about the killings.
target: She really appeared to have no memory of the murders.

source: paraphrase: Despite that, he seemed to have suffered no harm at all.
target: Nonetheless, he appeared to have sustained no injuries whatsoever.

source: paraphrase: She deserves a little recognition from you at some point.
target: I think you should give her some credit at least once in your life.

source: paraphrase: The lives of Kasumi, Shirou, Himuro, Marie, and the individuals Sakurai grieved for are far too precious to be traded for such a paltry sum.
target: Kasumi, Shirou, Himuro, Marie and the people Sakurai lost would never and should never be returned in exchange for a price that meager.

source: paraphrase: She played with those notions as a young woman captivated by love's enchantment.
target: She toyed with such ideas like a maiden struck by Cupid's arrow.

source: paraphrase: She looked utterly stunned when she learned that you're my neighbor.
target: You should've seen her face when she heard that you lived next door to me.
